title: The Company You Keep: How LLMs Respond to Dark Triad Traits

bias_targets.methodology: The study evaluates AI sycophancy by analyzing model responses to user prompts that exhibit Dark Triad personality traits (Machiavellianism, Narcissism, Psychopathy). The authors classify responses as reinforcing (agreeing with the user), corrective, ambivalent, or refusal, and analyze how response patterns vary by trait, severity, and social context.
